tool.name: Cosmic Ray
tool.execution_environment: eight disjoint WSL ext4 source-copy shards followed by survivor-only master reruns

scope_refinement: The final filter removes pre-existing P13 dash-normalization and P1 join/miter validation branches from the initially sharded P14 candidate set.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: Cap equality or inequality changes to a lexicographic ordering comparison.
premises: Live validation restricts cap values to butt, round, or square.
The capped-segment helper receives only round or square.
Python orders these values as butt < round < square.
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: On the validated set, cap != butt is identical to cap > butt, cap == butt is identical to cap <= butt, and within the capped helper cap == square is identical to cap >= square. Every branch decision is unchanged.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: Round-cap coordinate equality changes to object identity.
premises: Equal coordinate tuples describe a zero-length segment.
The endpoint disk uses the same bounds and RGBA fill for every repeated center.
ImageDraw fill assignment is idempotent for an identical disk.
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: For unequal values, identity and value comparisons select the same nonzero body and two centers. For equal distinct tuples, the mutant may draw a degenerate body or the same endpoint disk twice; the required disk covers the body and repeating the identical fill does not change any output pixel.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: A zero equality changes to less-than-or-equal zero.
premises: Modulo two of a nonnegative index is zero or one.
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: On each stated domain, x == 0 if and only if x <= 0. The tangent fallback, zero-length branch, zero dash selection, and even-slot selections are unchanged.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: The negative-distance normalization guard changes from distance < 0 to distance <= 0.
premises: The validated dash period is finite and strictly positive.
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: The predicates differ only at distance zero. At zero, the mutant adds ceil(-0 / period) * period = 0, so distance and all emitted centers remain unchanged.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: Operation-budget comparisons change from >= to == or from == 0 to <= 0.
premises: The caller supplies limit = MAX_DASH_STEPS - segment_count with 0 <= segment_count <= MAX_DASH_STEPS.
The unique-center count starts at zero and grows by exactly one after the pre-addition guard.
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: Limit is nonnegative, so limit == 0 and limit <= 0 agree. The pre-addition invariant len(distances) <= limit means len >= limit and len == limit first become true at the same count; the function raises before a count above limit can exist.

equivalent_survivor_proofs.mutation: The zero-length branch inserts positive or negative one instead of zero into the private distance set.
premises: This branch runs only when source length is zero.
After insertion the set is consumed only through its truth value, and the function returns the original start coordinate.
equivalent_survivor_proofs.proof: Zero, positive one, and negative one each make an empty set nonempty and do not make a nonempty set empty. Therefore the branch returns [start] in exactly the same cases and never exposes the inserted sentinel.
